newsitem.title: MEXICO: Accel SA places 85 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Accel SA places 85 million shares.

text.p: Accel S.A. de C.V. will conclude a public offering on Wednesday to place 85 million shares at a price of 1.82 pesos each, the company said in a report to the Mexican Stock Exchange.

Accel said it would place a total of 34 million shares and "B" series, and 51 million, "C" series, in share units comprising two "B" series and three "C" series shares each. The shares are equivalent to 24.73 percent of the company's share capital.
The IPO began on Tuesday, with BBV-Probursa brokerage as the leading placement agent.
Accelsa is a holding company for warehousing firms that also manufactures and markets clothing.
